SupperCraft name: which size?

Same bar every time: your board (N-r8-01), 56 tall, the app icon. Only the name changes.

Contrast = the cream name against the single lightest dot of wood behind it. Higher is easier to read; 4.5 is the usual pass mark for text this size. These are mock-ups, not screenshots of the app.
